title: Exact closed restriction on arbitrary element sites
statement: For a commutative ring sheaf R, actual element restriction has a natural derived internal-Hom comparison. Further restriction along every sheaf arrow admits the exact additive, K-injective, unit and derived-Hom data of RingedPresentationCore, with identity unit. For each site object U the module category on C/U is equivalent to the module category on the element site of the sheafified representable of U; its forward unit and derived Hom are compatible and the usual overFunctor corresponds to element restriction. Actual restriction additivity, exactness, colimits, K-injectivity, element-map continuity and relocalization are already proved in RingedPresentationData and are not asserted as unfinished parts here.

proof.text: Construct sectionwise internal Hom restriction by precomposition with the projection on slices. Its inverse lifts an arrow V to U to the element obtained by restricting the chosen section. The inverse laws follow from naturality along identity-underlying arrows, and the maps are linear and natural in both modules. Use the product limit characterization of each Hom-complex degree to construct a degreewise isomorphism. The projection formula for the differential and for pre/postcomposition proves compatibility and naturality.

Use the proved exactness and K-injective-preservation API for element restriction. Compute derived Hom after the canonical K-injective replacement in the second argument. Hom into a K-injective target inverts the replacement comparison. Restriction of the Hom complex thus compares both derived functors after precomposition with the product localization. Fully faithful whiskering by that localization descends the natural isomorphism.

For b:B to A take the fibre sheaf of b on the element site of A. Flattening its element site to the element site of B is fully faithful and essentially surjective. The lifted-cover topology formulas identify their covering sieves. Apply the ringed-equivalence module-Hom theorem to this site equivalence and its identity restricted ring map. The fibre condition gives a natural identity-underlying isomorphism between the two base projections. Transporting module pushforward along this isomorphism identifies composition with the module equivalence with actual further restriction. Transport exactness, sequential colimits, K-injectivity and derived Hom through this isomorphism, choosing the actual further restriction unit to be the identity.

For U use the functor from C/U to the element site of the sheafified representable that sends an arrow to its sheafification section. The existing equivalence with the slice over this sheaf and the element-site fibre equivalence identify its restriction on sheaves with an equivalence. Apply the ringed-equivalence module-Hom theorem to its identity restricted ring map. Its module inverse is the sectionwise restriction, so the equivalence counit identifies overFunctor followed by its module equivalence with actual element restriction.

theorem element_restriction_hom
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) :
    ∃ (s : ∀ {A B : Sheaf J (Type u)} (b : B ⟶ A),
        RingedPresentationCore (presentationElementRing R A) (presentationElementRing R B)
          (elementModulePullbackOver.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R) b
            (presentationElementRestriction_continuous b))),
      (∀ A : Sheaf J (Type u),
        Nonempty (presentationRHom R ⋙
          presentationDerivedMap (R := R) (S := presentationElementRing R A)
            (elementModulePullback.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R) A)
            (presentationElementRestriction_additive R A)
            (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).1
            (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).2.1 ≅
          ((presentationDerivedMap (R := R) (S := presentationElementRing R A)
            (elementModulePullback.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R) A)
              (presentationElementRestriction_additive R A)
              (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).1
              (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).2.1).op.prod
            (presentationDerivedMap (R := R) (S := presentationElementRing R A)
            (elementModulePullback.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R) A)
              (presentationElementRestriction_additive R A)
              (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).1
              (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).2.1)) ⋙
            presentationRHom (presentationElementRing R A))) ∧
      (∀ {A B : Sheaf J (Type u)} (b : B ⟶ A), (s b).unit = Iso.refl _) ∧
      ∀ U : C,
        ∃ E : RingedPresentationEquivalenceCore (R.over U)
          (presentationElementRing R ((presheafToSheaf J (Type u)).obj (yoneda.obj U))),
          Nonempty (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (localCoefficientRings R) U ⋙
            E.modules.functor ≅ elementModulePullback.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R)
              ((presheafToSheaf J (Type u)).obj (yoneda.obj U)))
